# windowsddi_dhcp_scope (Resource)

Manages an IPv4 scope (`Add-DhcpServerv4Scope`, `Set-DhcpServerv4Scope`, `Remove-DhcpServerv4Scope`).

If the scope is part of a failover relationship, manage it on one partner only and let replication run (or run `Invoke-DhcpServerv4FailoverReplication` afterwards).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "windowsddi_dhcp_scope" "users" {
  name           = "Users VLAN 120"
  description    = "Office users"
  start_range    = "10.1.20.10"
  end_range      = "10.1.20.250"
  subnet_mask    = "255.255.255.0"
  lease_duration = "8h" # or "0.08:00:00"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_range` (String) Last IPv4 address of the range the server leases from.
- `name` (String) Scope name.
- `start_range` (String) First IPv4 address of the range the server leases from. Changing it within the same network updates the scope in place; moving it to another network replaces the scope.
- `subnet_mask` (String) Subnet mask, for example `255.255.255.0`. Changing it replaces the scope (`Set-DhcpServerv4Scope` cannot change it).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Scope description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) When `true`, destroying the resource removes the scope even if it has active leases (`-Force`). Defaults to `false`. Terraform only, not read from the server.
- `lease_duration` (String) Lease duration as `d.hh:mm:ss` (for example `8.00:00:00`, the default) or a Go duration (for example `8h`, `90m`, `192h`). Equivalent spellings never show a diff.
- `state` (String) `Active` (default) or `InActive`.
- `type` (String) Clients served: `Dhcp` (default), `Bootp` or `Both`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `scope_id`.
- `scope_id` (String) Scope ID: the network address, derived from `start_range` and `subnet_mask`. Known at plan time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by scope ID (the network address).
terraform import windowsddi_dhcp_scope.users 10.1.20.0
```
